parsed.name: Sensirion 传感器桥接器
parsed.description: 一款通过 USB 连接电脑并提供双路 I2C 端口的硬件桥接设备，用于在实验中接入、配置和通信 Sensirion 或其他兼容 I2C 的传感器模块，便于传感器测试、数据采集与调试。
parsed.description_en: A hardware USB-to-I2C bridge that connects to a computer and exposes two I2C ports for laboratory communication with Sensirion and other compatible I2C sensor modules, enabling sensor setup, testing, data acquisition, and debugging.

actions.description: 初始化传感器桥接器并建立通信连接。
actions.description_en: Initialize the sensor bridge and establish communication.

actions.description: 配置指定桥接口的 I2C 设备参数，如供电电压和总线频率。
actions.description_en: Configure an I2C device on the selected bridge port, including supply voltage and bus frequency.

actions.description: 禁用指定桥接口上的 I2C 设备。
actions.description_en: Disable the I2C device on the selected bridge port.

actions.description: 输出 I2C 设备的信息以便识别和调试。
actions.description_en: Print information about the I2C device for identification and debugging.

actions.description: 向指定 I2C 地址发送命令并读取返回字节数据。
actions.description_en: Send a command to the specified I2C address and read back response bytes.

actions.description: 向指定 I2C 地址写入命令或数据。
actions.description_en: Write a command or data payload to the specified I2C address.

actions.description: 关闭桥接器连接并释放通信资源。
actions.description_en: Close the bridge connection and release communication resources.
